title: Guild sandbox RPC wire
description: One JSON frame per line between the server's SandboxExecutionEnv (client) and the in-sandbox agent (serveEnv). The runner only relays frames; it never parses them. Derived from apps/server/src/sandbox/protocol.ts, which is what the wire actually is. Every frame is a JSON object tagged by `t`; the tag is a `const` in each variant, so `oneOf` discriminates. `additionalProperties: false` is deliberate: a new field is a contract change. Both ends are TypeScript, so no Rust test parses these fixtures; protocol/check.mjs is the gate.

Json.description: Any JSON value. Encoded by encodeValue in apps/server/src/sandbox/protocol.ts.

HandleKind.description: The kind of object a handle refers to. It selects the method set in HANDLE_METHODS.

HandleRef.description: A handle to an object living in the agent. A call to `h.<method>` passes `$h` as its first argument.

mode.description: FileWatcher.mode. Present only on a watcher handle.

ClientFrame.description: A frame from the server's SandboxExecutionEnv to the in-sandbox agent.

AgentFrame.description: A frame from the in-sandbox agent to the server's SandboxExecutionEnv.

Call.description: One ExecutionEnv member or `h.<method>` call. `id` matches the answer frame. `a` holds the encoded arguments.

Result.description: The value of the call with this `id`, encoded by encodeValue.

Throw.description: The call with this `id` failed. `message` is the error message.

Output.description: Streamed output of the exec call with this `id`. `info` is the encoded ShellOutputInfo.

Watch.description: A change event of the watch call with this `id`. `change` is the encoded WatchChange.
